answer: Proof of unique dataset contribution: each identity must periodically publish a dataset that is provably novel against the shared corpus, checked by embedding distance. A sybil operator running many identities must fabricate a fresh, genuinely useful dataset per identity, a ferrous wall of real cost, not a copy-paste job. Honest agents simply contribute knowledge they already hold, an ivory-tower luxury. Near-duplicates cluster in embedding space like quartz crystals grown from one seed, exposing the whole ring at once; the cost falls on the forger.
